description: Search 14 600+ Medicare/Medicaid-certified nursing homes and long-term care facilities in the US with CMS 5-star quality ratings. Filter by state, city, ZIP code, name, minimum overall rating, and ownership type (for-profit, non-profit, government). Returns CMS Certification Number (CCN), provider name, address, phone, ownership, certified bed count, and four separate quality ratings: overall (1–5 stars), health inspection, staffing, and quality measures. Star ratings help families compare nursing homes objectively for long-term care placement. No auth — US Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services public domain, unlimited free.

city.description: City or town name to filter nursing homes (partial match). Example: "Miami", "Chicago".

limit.description: Maximum number of nursing homes to return (1–100, default 20).

min_rating.description: Minimum CMS Overall Star Rating (1–5 stars). Higher ratings indicate better quality of care based on health inspections, staffing levels, and quality measures.

name.description: Partial nursing home name to search (case-insensitive substring match). Example: "Sunrise", "Brookdale", "Manor".

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0).

ownership_type.description: Filter by ownership type. Common values: "For profit - Corporation", "Non profit - Corporation", "Government - State", "Government - County", "For profit - Individual".

state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation to filter nursing homes (e.g. FL, CA, TX).

zip_code.description: 5-digit US ZIP code to filter nursing homes by location.

name: cms.nursing_home.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: CMS — US Nursing Home Search
